title: The Stolen Ionic Shield
logline: An orbital shipyard engineer hires a pilot to test an experimental ionic shield in pulsar space, discovering that the shield's electromagnetic backwash will permanently burn out the system's solar storm warning relay.

roles.description: Senior propulsion tester for an orbital shipyard; brilliant, dedicated, and alarmed by dangerous test parameters.
Vice-president of drydock development; slick, aggressive, and racing to meet a deadline with massive penalty clauses.
Veteran operator of the system's deep-space storm warning array; stubborn, tired, and protective of habitat safety.
A heavy private security frigate sent to ensure the commercial test schedule proceeds without interruption.
A violently turbulent space corridor exposed to direct pulsar radiation flares.
The massive drydock slipway where capital freighters and defensive shields are fitted.
The fragile communications buoy array that alerts asteroid mining settlements to incoming lethal solar storms.
The independent belt worker collective whose habitats rely on early solar flare warnings.

public_situation: Shipyard executives announce an open-corridor test of a heavy ionic pulsar shield capable of withstanding extreme stellar radiation.
private_truth: The shield prototype's ionic pulse backwash will permanently burn out the system's early solar storm warning relay, leaving thousands of asteroid miners blind to lethal flares.

beats.public_change: Promotional holos display shield test schedules as armed guards seal {role:orbital_shipwright_slipway}.

missions.reason: She pays an outside pilot to mount the experimental ionic shield generator onto a test hull before shipyard executives arrive.
missions.private_fact: The prototype's calibration logs show a pulse backwash five times stronger than stated in the public licensing filing.

beats.public_change: Pulsar flare activity rises as {role:relay_watchman} broadcasts warnings that the testing corridor encroaches on public buoy channels.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to fly through the test corridor and scan the electromagnetic feedback line to determine if the relay array is in the discharge arc.
missions.private_fact: She knows that if the full-power test fires, the relay array's fragile quartz transceivers will be permanently fused.

beats.public_change: {role:relay_watchman} locks emergency storm beacons, threatening to file criminal hazard injunctions against the shipyard.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to deliver emergency ceramic dampener coils from the relay station to the slipway so technicians can shield the array before ignition.
missions.private_fact: His daughter works an unshielded prospecting rig that will be vaporized if a pulsar flare hits without fifteen minutes of relay warning.

beats.public_change: {role:corporate_escort_vessel} arrives on range, ordering all civilian traffic cleared for immediate ignition.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to disable the corporate escort's command relay before it transmits the override signal to fire the unshielded test pulse.
missions.private_fact: The corporate captain hails mid-combat offering a massive equipment bonus if the pilot ignores the relay and fires the test generator.

player_choice.prompt: With the corporate escort disabled and the lethal pulse telemetry verified, the pilot must decide whether to abort the test to save the warning network, jury-rig directional dampeners, or fire the pulse for the executive's payout.

options.label: Abort the test and transmit the discharge telemetry to the miners' union to shut down the testing range
Install the dampener coils and execute a reduced-power deflection run to protect the relay while certifying the shield
Fire the full-power test pulse to claim the corporate performance bonus

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot aborts the test and leaks the discharge telemetry to the miners' union.
resolutions.summary: The test is shut down. {role:miners_mutual_union} preserves its storm warning relay, while {role:shipyard_executive} is dismissed for criminal negligence.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot aborted a reckless corporate shield test that would have blinded a system's solar flare warning network.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot installs dampeners and conducts a reduced-power test run.
resolutions.summary: The shield passes restricted trials without damaging {role:warning_relay_array}. {role:testing_engineer} earns a patent share, while the shipyard absorbs minor delay penalties.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced an orbital shipyard to retrofit experimental pulsar shields with civic safety dampeners.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fires the full-power test pulse for the corporate payout.
resolutions.summary: The shield passes full certification. The warning relay is burned out, leaving miners vulnerable to pulsar flares while {role:shipyard_executive} pockets a fortune.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot triggered a corporate shield test that permanently burned out an asteroid belt's storm warning relay.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the defense.
resolutions.summary: An unmitigated pulse overloads the testing corridor, destroying the prototype generator and crippling {role:warning_relay_array}. The shipyard cancels the program in disgrace.

loose_threads.detail: The port authority maintenance ledger records that repair credits for the solar warning buoy were quietly reallocated to the shipyard slipway.
The prototype generator's high-voltage busbars bear serial stamps from an off-world transit foundry dissolved under monopoly regulations.

radio_hooks: Shipyard consortia tout impending commercial rollout of revolutionary pulsar shield.
Belt miners lodge formal protests over high-power testing near public navigation corridors.
Pulsar radiation storms prompt temporary travel warnings across inner perimeter lanes.

voice_direction.testing_engineer: Methodical, crisp, and speaks with scientific enthusiasm that turns tense and defensive when civic hazards are raised.
voice_direction.shipyard_executive: Effortlessly smooth, rapid, and speaks exclusively in investment portfolio jargon. Discards human concerns as sentimentality.
voice_direction.relay_watchman: Blunt, raspy from dry recycler air, and speaks with furious protective urgency. Refuses corporate technical euphemisms.
